stdout:
usage: fleet-switchboard plan [-h] {check,template,review} ...

positional arguments:
  {check,template,review}
    check               Check a plan: scenarios well-formed, every Done-when
                        clause covered; prints PASS or FAIL, one line per
                        defect, and the plan's content hash
    template            Print a prefilled plan for an ask: its Done-when
                        clauses and one scenario stub per clause (read-only)
    review              The plan review engine (off unless
                        plan_review.enabled): adversarial lanes, at most 3
                        rounds

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
